name.en: Texas State Highway 71 — the 10th Mountain Division Highway
name.zh: 得克萨斯 71 号州道（第 10 山地师公路）

tagline.en: Brady to the Gulf coastal plain, through Austin's airport
tagline.zh: 自布雷迪至墨西哥湾沿海平原，穿过奥斯汀机场

mileageSource: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 71, certified mileage open to traffic, 2010

start.en: US 87 about two miles south of Brady
start.zh: 布雷迪以南约两英里的 US 87

end.en: SH 35 about 1.5 miles east of Blessing
end.zh: 布莱辛以东约 1.5 英里的 SH 35

en: SH 71 runs 253.199 miles diagonally across central Texas, from the edge of the Hill Country south of Brady to the coastal plain near Blessing. Along the way it takes in Llano, the western approach to Austin, Bastrop, Smithville, La Grange, Columbus and El Campo, crossing twelve counties.

It is really three roads. West of Austin it is a two-lane Hill Country highway through Llano and Burnet county ranchland. Through Austin it is a freeway — the main surface approach to Austin-Bergstrom International Airport and one of the busiest pieces of state highway in central Texas. East of Bastrop it settles into the post-oak and blackland farm country and then the flat rice-growing coastal prairie.

The formal name applies only to part of it. Under a 1995 Act of the Texas Legislature, the 10th Mountain Division Highway covers US 290 from I-35 to SH 95, the part of SH 95 between them, and the part of SH 71 from SH 95 to I-35.
zh: SH 71 全长 253.199 英里，斜向穿过得州中部，自布雷迪以南的山丘乡野边缘至布莱辛附近的沿海平原。沿途经过拉诺、奥斯汀西侧进城路段、巴斯特罗普、史密斯维尔、拉格兰奇、哥伦布与埃尔坎波，跨越十二个县。
它实际上是三条路。奥斯汀以西是穿行拉诺县与伯内特县牧场的双车道山丘乡野公路。穿过奥斯汀时它是一条高速公路——通往奥斯汀—伯格斯特龙国际机场的主要地面通道，也是得州中部最繁忙的州道路段之一。巴斯特罗普以东，它进入柞栎与黑土农业地带，最后是平坦的水稻种植沿海草原。
正式路名只适用于其中一部分。依据得州议会 1995 年的一项法案，第 10 山地师公路涵盖 I-35 至 SH 95 之间的 US 290、两者之间的 SH 95 路段，以及 SH 71 自 SH 95 至 I-35 的路段。

en: TxDOT's designation file traces a route that kept being extended at both ends. In the general redescription of September 1939 SH 71 ran only from Bastrop through Smithville, La Grange, Columbus, El Campo and Midfield to SH 35 — the Austin end had been dropped four years earlier when US 290 was codesignated over it.

Austin came back in May 1951, when US 290 was rerouted further north and SH 71 was extended from Bastrop into the city. The western half followed in 1965: the route was carried on from Austin to Brady by cancelling Ranch to Market Roads 93 and 734 and combining them into SH 71.

The last significant change was local. In February 1982 the route was redescribed to record its relocation at Columbus, bypassing the town; the old alignment through it eventually became a business route. The pattern is the usual one for a long Texas state highway — a short original road that grew by absorbing lesser numbered roads at either end.
zh: 得州交通部的路线划定档案记录了一条两端不断延长的道路。在 1939 年 9 月的整体重新描述中，SH 71 只从巴斯特罗普经史密斯维尔、拉格兰奇、哥伦布、埃尔坎波与米德菲尔德通至 SH 35——奥斯汀一端在四年前已因 US 290 共线而被取消。
奥斯汀在 1951 年 5 月回归：US 290 改线至更北处，SH 71 自巴斯特罗普延伸入城。西半段随后在 1965 年加入：通过撤销 93 号与 734 号农市道路并将其并入 SH 71，路线自奥斯汀延长至布雷迪。
最后一次重要变动是局部性的。1982 年 2 月，路线重新描述以记录其在哥伦布的改线，绕过该镇；穿镇的旧线位后来成为商业支线。这一模式在得州长途州道中相当典型——一条不长的原始道路，通过在两端并入编号较小的道路而变长。

en: The Austin section is where the numbers get large. TxDOT records that average daily traffic on SH 71 just east of SH 130 was more than 50,000 vehicles a day in 2015, and its stated reason for working on the corridor is population growth in eastern Travis and Bastrop counties.

The response has been to remove signals one at a time. TxDOT is building an overpass over the signalised intersection at Tucker Hill Lane in Bastrop County, with one-way frontage roads and improved cycling and walking provision; the project is costed at $58.5 million and anticipated to finish in the autumn of 2028.

More of the same is queued behind it. Overpasses are planned at Pope Bend Road and at FM 1209, the latter with an anticipated letting date of 2030 — which is a reasonable indication of how long the road is expected to keep absorbing growth.
zh: 奥斯汀路段是数字变大的地方。得州交通部记载，2015 年 SH 71 在 SH 130 以东不远处的日均交通量超过 50,000 辆；其对该走廊动工的明确理由是特拉维斯县东部与巴斯特罗普县的人口增长。
应对办法是逐个取消信号交叉口。得州交通部正在巴斯特罗普县塔克山道的信号交叉口上方修建跨线桥，配套单向辅道并改善自行车与步行设施；项目造价 5,850 万美元，预计 2028 年秋季完工。
后面还排着同类工程。波普本德路与 FM 1209 处均规划了跨线桥，后者预计 2030 年招标——这也相当清楚地说明，人们预期这条路还要消化多久的增长。

figures.source: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 71, certified mileage 2010

value.en: Twelve: McCulloch, San Saba, Mason, Llano, Burnet, Blanco, Travis, Bastrop, Fayette, Colorado, Wharton and Matagorda
value.zh: 十二个：麦卡洛克、圣萨巴、梅森、拉诺、伯内特、布兰科、特拉维斯、巴斯特罗普、费耶特、科罗拉多、沃顿与马塔戈达

figures.source: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 71, Adm. Ltr. 002-1982

value.zh: 5,850 万美元，预计 2028 年秋季完工

figures.source: TxDOT, SH 71 East Corridor project page

why.en: No total exists. The highway grew from a short 1920s route by absorbing farm and ranch roads at both ends over four decades, and TxDOT accounts for spending by project.
why.zh: 并无总数。这条公路由 1920 年代的一段短路，在四十年间通过两端并入农场与牧场道路而扩展，得州交通部按项目核算支出。

label.en: Average daily traffic east of SH 130
label.zh: SH 130 以东的日均交通量

value.en: More than 50,000 vehicles a day in 2015

trafficFigures.source: TxDOT, SH 71 East Corridor project page

why.en: No route-level figure could be verified. This route runs from a two-lane road in McCulloch County to an urban freeway at Austin's airport, so a single average would be misleading.
why.zh: 未能查证到全线数据。本路线既有麦卡洛克县的双车道公路，也有奥斯汀机场旁的城市高速，单一平均值会造成误导。

timeline.en: SH 71 is redescribed as running only from Bastrop to SH 35, the Austin end having been given over to US 290.
timeline.zh: SH 71 重新描述为仅自巴斯特罗普通至 SH 35，奥斯汀一端已让给 US 290。

timeline.en: US 290 is rerouted north and SH 71 is extended from Bastrop back into Austin.
timeline.zh: US 290 北移改线，SH 71 自巴斯特罗普重新延伸入奥斯汀。

timeline.en: The route is extended from Austin to Brady over cancelled Ranch to Market Roads 93 and 734.
timeline.zh: 路线沿被撤销的 93 号与 734 号农市道路自奥斯汀延伸至布雷迪。

timeline.en: The route is relocated at Columbus, bypassing the town.
timeline.zh: 路线在哥伦布改线，绕过该镇。

timeline.en: The Legislature names part of the route the 10th Mountain Division Highway, effective 1 September.
timeline.zh: 州议会将部分路段命名为第 10 山地师公路，9 月 1 日生效。

timeline.en: The Tucker Hill Lane overpass in Bastrop County is anticipated to be complete.
timeline.zh: 巴斯特罗普县塔克山道跨线桥预计完工。
